title: Moiré from two ring screens

reference.grammar: two-ink stochastic print: blue dot lattice from two ring gratings, red radial core, cream margin; grain is the screening itself

techniques.name: Concentric ring grating
techniques.limits: Pitches within ~4 u of each other push the beat fringe past the sheet; equal pitches collapse the moiré to one ring set. Below ~30 u the rings alias into the screen.
techniques.implementation: g(p) = 0.5+0.5·cos(2π·|p−c|/pitch) for each grating; the floor keeps a base blue coverage so the field never drops to paper.

techniques.name: Grating product (moiré)
techniques.limits: knee_lo ≥ knee_hi inverts the smoothstep. gamma below ~0.8 fills the lattice to a flat tint; above ~2.5 the dots shrink to specks.
techniques.implementation: Multiplying the two gratings gives a dot lattice where both are high and long beat fringes where their phases drift; nothing is drawn as a dot — the lattice is the product.

techniques.name: Radial red core

cutoff.note: red coverage below this prints nothing

techniques.limits: gain above ~2 saturates the core to a flat disc; sigma above ~700 u floods the sheet and the blue lattice no longer reads through.
techniques.implementation: Red coverage is a clipped gaussian of distance from the core; inside it the blue lattice overprints as a lighter pink, which is how the rings read through the red.

techniques.name: Stochastic two-ink screen

params.threshold: uniform random per pixel per ink
params.overprint: where both inks land: overCore pink in the field, overFar plum on lattice dots (product > plum_above) inside the core

techniques.limits: soften above ~1.5 px dissolves the lattice into tone; cell_px is fixed at 1 in this rebuild (a coarser cell needs a hash per cell, not per pixel).
techniques.implementation: For each device pixel: blue if r1 < blue_coverage, red if r2 < red_coverage; both → overprint; neither → paper tint. A 0.6 px blur softens the pixel edges the way the reference’s scan does.

techniques.name: Cream margin
techniques.limits: Above ~120 u the margin crops the beat fringe at the left edge.
techniques.implementation: Flat cream fill; the print sits inset by 34 u on every side.

pass_order: gratings · A and B evaluated per pixel
coverage · blue = product, red = radial × A
screen · random threshold per ink, overprint where both
notes: Measured on ref.png: ring pitch ≈ 50 px at 735 px (68 u); grain std ≈ 20/255 in flat regions; hot red (241,57,29) 3.6 % of pixels; saturated blue (72,130,183) 11.5 %.
